task: Binary presence of three selected word families in one-second clips

early_cnn_curves.normalization: Training-only global log-mel mean and standard deviation
early_cnn_curves.curves: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation across five seeds, without smoothing
early_cnn_curves.selection: Minimum validation BCE separately per seed and epoch budget
early_cnn_curves.limits: Compare normalization at equal epochs up to 100. The normalized continuation to 300 has a larger update and selection budget. Same reused validation; no test evaluation.
